description_for_human: Mint AI-themed NFT cards on Base Sepolia
description_for_model: Mint Cards Against Humanity style NFT cards with AI/tech humor. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402 protocol. Agents need: 1) EVM wallet, 2) Testnet USDC from faucet, 3) x402 client for payment signing. Use GET /api/cards to discover available cards, then POST /api/agent-mint with selected card indices to mint.
